The '''UR-5292-FH system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained a [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]], an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] and two [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The UR-5292-FH system was established in the [[2011]] novel [[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']], written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].
